messages:
kate-cust: Hey, saw a spike of 401s for our app right after we rotated API keys and also occasional 3-5s latency on embeddings. I have one request id: req_9a8f7e6d. Can someone tell me what to capture to repro?

mira-support: thanks — can you share the minimal curl + SDK snippet you used? also env (region, token method). 401 suggests token mismatch but the latency is odd.

kate-cust: minimal curl is below. Using hosted Redwood API in us-west2, token is from our vault and rotated via CI. We only saw the 401s for ~2 minutes then recovered.

kate-cust: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["hello world"]}'
```

kate-cust: python SDK call (very minimal):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-large", input=["hello world"])
print(resp)
```

mira-support: good — couple quick asks: (1) when you hit the 401, can you capture the full response headers (we need x-request-id or x-rw-request-id if present)? (2) enable SDK debug logging to capture auth header in memory (don't paste secrets) and post redacted logs. (3) collect a debug bundle with the request ids and any local proxy logs.

dan-eng: adding minimal repro snippets for go/js that mirror your calls — please run these during the incident so we get consistent request ids.

dan-eng: JS (node) quick snippet:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-large', input: ['hello world'] })
```

dan-eng: Go quick snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Embeddings.Create(context.Background(), redwood.EmbeddingsCreateParams{Model: "embed-large", Input: []string{"hello world"}})
fmt.Println(resp, err)
```

ashley-sre: if you can reproduce the 401, grab the exact timestamp (UTC) and the server response body + headers. also include your client time drift (ntp check) — rare but we've seen rotated tokens fail if clock skew & short-lived creds.

kate-cust: got it. one extra weirdness: the returned 401 had a body: `{\"error\":{\"type\":\"auth_error\",\"message\":\"invalid token\"}}` — but the token in CI matched the one in vault at the time. i will run the snippets and paste redacted logs + request ids.

mira-support: ideal debug bundle items: list of commands and outputs to include in a single archive:
- SDK debug logs (python/js/go) with DEBUG=redwood or equivalent
- curl -v output for the failing req id
- your app logs around the incident with local timestamps
- `env | grep REDWOOD` (redact key) and `date -u +%s` (UTC epoch)
- tracer/span ids if you have distributed tracing

support-bot: To collect debug bundle, run `/collect-debug-bundle` (internal tool). It will gather env, last 2k lines of local logs, and prompt you to paste request ids. Link: https://internal.redwood.tools/collect-debug-bundle

kate-cust: running now, will paste bundle link + the first three request ids (req_9a8f7e6d, req_9a8f7e70, req_9a8f7e71) once ready.

sre-jamie: once we have the bundle, SRE will correlate those request ids against ingress logs and the auth service. if we see token validation failures, we'll check KMS rotations and cached secrets in edge proxies. also we'll look for any autoscaling or GC pauses that could explain the latency spike.

mira-support: one more helpful minimal capture: run this curl that prints response headers and a unique client nonce — replace $REDWOOD_KEY and paste the full output (redact token):
```
curl -i -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Client-Nonce: test-$(date +%s)" \\n  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["a"]}'
```

kate-cust: done — uploaded bundle to the tool and pasted link: https://internal.redwood.tools/bundles/ba1f2e. I included the curl outputs and SDK debug logs with redacted keys. first failing req was at 2026-03-16T22:13:04Z (req_9a8f7e6d).

mira-support: perfect. we'll take it from here, triage SRE + eng. if we need a live repro window we'll DM to coordinate short test window. thanks for the quick captures :thumbsup:

kate-cust: thanks all, appreciate it!
